description: Installation of a temporary two storey mobile unit to be used as changing rooms
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (28261138 - PL 04, 28261138 - PL - 001, 28261138 - PL- 02 and 28261138 - PL 03 received on 20/05/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The windows formed at first floor level in the building hereby permitted shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.

Condition : 4 - The building hereby permitted shall be used as ancillary school facilities and shall not be occupied as a separate school and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class D1 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987, or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification).
Condition : 5 - Prior to 1st September 2021, the temporary building, hardstanding and fencing hereby approved shall be removed from the site and the ground returned to its former state.
